prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1439; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'm sorry, I'd rather keep my name off the recording for now. You can use my claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on the main road in Pearland, heading toward the shopping center near the intersection.

Q: What was the weather and road condition like?

A: It was clear and dry. Traffic was moderate, nothing unusual.

Q: Can you describe how the collision happened?

A: The other car crossed into my lane. I braked and turned slightly, but we still hit head-on. It wasn't very fast. I'd guess we were both going maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour.

Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway?

A: No, both cars stayed in their lanes after impact, more or less.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, and the airbag deployed on my side.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the accident?

A: Not right away. I felt stiff in the lower back within an hour or so, and by the next morning it was pretty sore.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following day. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do physical therapy.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any pain or limitations?

A: Yes, I have trouble sitting for long periods and bending over. I've been off some of my regular work duties while I recover.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was cooperative with the police and I want this handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
